gaps.sentence: ___ the investors backed the plan enthusiastically, but they withdrew after the scandal.
gaps.hint: at the start, not the end
gaps.explanation: 'Initially' contrasts the early support with the later withdrawal.

gaps.sentence: My sister is terribly reserved, ___ I'll talk to complete strangers.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' contrasts two parallel facts: her nature versus mine.

gaps.sentence: The results were inconclusive. ___, the team repeated the whole experiment.
gaps.explanation: The inconclusive results caused the repetition: Therefore is the only result linker.

gaps.sentence: ___ it rains all weekend, the ceremony will still be held outdoors.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a possible (not yet real) condition.

gaps.sentence: I can't afford a holiday this year; ___, I can't get the time off work.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides' adds a further, often decisive, reason in informal style.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we arrived ___ the storm broke.
gaps.explanation: 'Hardly... when' is the fixed pair for one event interrupting another.

gaps.sentence: ___ she was utterly exhausted, she stayed to help clear up.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' concedes a known fact: she was exhausted and still stayed.

gaps.sentence: ___ he had studied hard, he failed the exam.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' concedes a full clause; due/owing take noun phrases.
